verse.verse_1: A doubter once demanded that punishment be immediately meted out,
verse.verse_2: to those who deny the truth. No power can hinder God
verse.verse_3: from punishing them. He is the Lord of the Ascending Stairways,
verse.verse_4: by which the angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him in one Day which will last for fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_5: Therefore, [O believers] behave with seemly patience.
verse.verse_6: They see it [the Day of Judgement] to be far off,
verse.verse_7: but We see it near at hand.
verse.verse_8: On that Day the heavens shall become like molten brass,
verse.verse_9: and the mountains will become like tufts of wool,
verse.verse_10: and no friend will ask about his friend,
verse.verse_11: though they shall be within sight of each other. The guilty one will gladly ransom himself from the torment of that Day by sacrificing his own children,
verse.verse_13: and his kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
verse.verse_14: and all the people of the earth, if that could deliver him.
verse.verse_15: But no! There is a raging blaze
verse.verse_17: and it will claim all those who turned their backs [on the true faith] and turned away [from the truth],
verse.verse_18: and amassed wealth and hoarded it.
verse.verse_20: when misfortune touches him he starts lamenting,
verse.verse_21: and whenever good fortune comes to him, he grows niggardly.
verse.verse_24: those who give a due share of their wealth
verse.verse_25: to those who ask [for help] and to the destitute;
verse.verse_26: and those who believe in the Day of Judgement
verse.verse_27: and are fearful of the punishment of their Lord;
verse.verse_28: for none may ever feel secure from the punishment of their Lord;
verse.verse_30: except from their spouses and those whom they rightfully possess [through wedlock], for which they incur no blame --
verse.verse_31: but those who go beyond that limit are transgressors;
verse.verse_32: and those who are faithful to their trusts and to their pledges;
verse.verse_33: and those who stand by their testimony
verse.verse_34: and are steadfast in their prayers.
verse.verse_35: They will be honoured in the Gardens of Bliss.
verse.verse_36: But what is the matter with those who deny the truth, that they come hastening towards you
verse.verse_37: from the right and from the left, in crowds?
verse.verse_38: Does every one of them aspire to be admitted into a Garden of Delight?
verse.verse_39: Certainly not! They know quite well out of what We created them.
verse.verse_40: But nay! I call to witness the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We have the power
verse.verse_41: to replace them with others better than them: nothing can prevent Us from doing this,
verse.verse_42: so leave them to indulge in vain idle talk and amuse themselves, until they face the Day which they have been promised,
verse.verse_43: the Day when they shall come out of their graves in haste, as if they were racing to a goal,
verse.verse_44: with downcast eyes and faces distorted in shame; such is the Day which they are promised.
